content:
Maya: Quick smoke bring-up for knockout-3b embeddings. Brought model into staging with fp16 and int8 (per-channel) quant. Ran holdout similarity + recall sweep on random 10k dataset. Int4 failing badly. Details below.

Maya: Command run:
```bash
./eval_embeddings --model knockout-3b --quant int8 --dataset holdout-10k --seed 42 --metrics recall@1,recall@10,cosine_mean,silhouette --output s3://ci/runs/knockout/1763334444
```

Josh: Nice — quick numbers?

Maya: Summary:
- baseline (fp16): recall@1 0.752, recall@10 0.927, silhouette 0.48
- int8 (per-channel): recall@1 0.741 (-1.5%), recall@10 0.912 (-1.6%), silhouette 0.46
- int4: recall@10 drop ~6% -> unusable

Ravi: Per-language breakdown?

Maya: en: -0.9% r@10, es: -2.3%, zh: -3.1% (int8)

Tian: Clustering/UMAP artifacts?

Maya: UMAP shows tighter clusters, some tail collapse for zh long-tail. Silhouette drop consistent with recall.

Ophelia: Our onboarding guardrail is 2% recall@10 drop for GA models. int8 is borderline fail on multi-lang.

Maya: Agreed. Thoughts: try symmetric per-channel quant (we used asymmetric) + retrain calibration with mixed-precision calibration set. Also can attempt split-quant: fp16 for prefix tokens, int8 for body to protect short-query recall.

Ravi: I'll queue ONNX per-channel run and a hybrid fp16/int8 pass. assigning to @ravi. Job ids will be posted.

ci-bot: Job queued: eval-1763334444-onnx-perchannel (ETA ~2h) :gear:

Maya: If ONNX per-channel reduces zh drop to <1.5% we can move to canary. Otherwise mark as blocked for GA.

Josh: Thx — keep notes in the model bringup doc and add the short prompts that regressed.

Maya: Will add examples and the seed split to the PR. Also saving embedding distances & nearest-neighbor diffs to s3.

Ophelia: Ping me when ONNX run completes. If we can get config to meet threshold, opt for canary rollout behind traffic split and monitor regression alerts.

Ravi: ack, starting now.

Maya: :thumbsup:
